chooseDay: Jump to a day or date
storageUnavailable: Layout is temporary: local storage is unavailable.
noPanels: Add a panel to build your workspace.
transitUnavailable: Transit routes and travel times are not connected yet.
riskEmpty: No verified risk data for this day.
researchNote: Illustrative research, not a live search.
appliedNote: The approved café compromise is now in this demo itinerary.
chatEmpty: Start a discussion with your group.
aiIntro: Ask about this trip. Tripify reads your itinerary, members and budget before answering. AI proposes — your group decides.
aiEmpty: Ask Tripify anything about this trip, e.g. “What fits a slow pace on day 2?”
aiSlow: Still working — the model is taking longer than usual.
aiTimeout: Tripify AI timed out after 90 seconds. Nothing changed — try a shorter question.
aiQuotaExhausted: Daily free-model quota reached (50/day without credits). Add $10+ credits on OpenRouter for 1000/day, or try tomorrow.
aiCreditsExhausted: OpenRouter credits exhausted (402). Free models also need a positive balance — top up, then retry.
aiFailed: Tripify AI is temporarily unavailable. Your workspace is unchanged — try again.
aiNotConfigured: Tripify AI is not configured on this server (missing OpenRouter key).
aiSignIn: Sign in to use Tripify AI.
filmIntro: Export your trip as a video, with every day, activity and planned cost. The file is generated on this device.
filmUnsupported: Video encoding is unavailable in this browser. Try the latest Chrome or Edge.
filmFailed: The video could not be created. Please try again.
